canvas_id.desc: Canvas the caller owns to turn into a skill. Send exactly one of `instructions` or `canvas_id`. One, and only one, of `instructions` and `canvas_id` is required.

category.desc: One of the skill categories. _Acceptable values:_ `communication` `customer_support` `data_and_analytics` `engineering` `product_management` `productivity` `professional_development` `project_management` `sales` `system` `team_management` `other`

description.desc: When Slackbot should use the skill. Max 400 characters.

display_name.desc: Human-readable label. Max 255 characters; not unique.

example_prompt.desc: Max 200 characters. May contain `{skill}`, which becomes the skill mention.

instructions.desc: Markdown body of the skill. Send exactly one of `instructions` or `canvas_id`. One, and only one, of `instructions` and `canvas_id` is required.

mcp_servers.desc: Apps the skill needs, capped at the caller's MCP server limit. Declaring an app doesn't grant access to it.

desc: Creates a skill from markdown instructions, or turns an existing canvas the caller owns into a skill.

errors.already_a_skill: The canvas is already a skill. Use `slackbot.skills.update` to change it.
errors.canvas_creation_failed: The skill's canvas couldn't be created.
errors.canvas_disabled_user_team: Canvases are disabled for the caller's team.
errors.canvas_editing_locked: Another edit to the canvas is in progress. Retry the request.
errors.canvas_not_found: The canvas doesn't exist or the caller can't see it.
errors.feature_not_enabled: The Skills API isn't enabled for this organization.
errors.free_teams_cannot_create_standalone_canv: Free teams can't create standalone canvases.
errors.invalid_category: `category` isn't one of the skill categories.
errors.is_a_template: Canvas templates can't be turned into skills.
errors.mcp_server_not_found: One or more declared apps don't exist or aren't available to the caller. `invalid_mcp_servers` lists them.
errors.not_canvas_owner: Only the canvas owner can turn it into a skill.
errors.restricted_action: The caller isn't allowed to author skills.
errors.too_many_mcp_servers: More apps were declared than the caller can enable at once.
